# Calc_portfolio — Claude Code instructions

The global engineering rules in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` are loaded automatically in
every session and are **in force in this repository**. This file adds project
context. It never relaxes the global rules.

## Non-negotiables, restated

- **Plan first.** Plan mode for anything with 3+ steps. The plan lives in
  `tasks/todo.md`; corrections received from the user go to `tasks/lessons.md`.
- **Skills before approach.** Name the skill(s) you will use — or state that
  none applies and why — before writing code.
- **Commit every turn.** Any turn that changes a file ends with a commit:
  Conventional Commits, English, ≤ 72 characters, imperative mood, and no
  mention of any AI tool, model or assistant in the message.
- **Prove it.** Nothing is done until tests pass, the build passes, or the
  behaviour has been demonstrated.
- **Simplicity, root causes, minimal blast radius.**

## Project

- **What it is**: French-language desktop calculator (Swing) built as a portfolio
  project: + - * / power, square root, reusable and persistent history.
  Money-grade decimal handling via `BigDecimal`.
- **Stack**: Java (JDK 17 is installed; CI/POM target arrives with Epic E1), Swing,
  no dependencies. Windows-first PowerShell scripts. No build tool and no CI yet.
- **Entry points**: `Main.java` (wires engine + file store -> presenter -> frame).
  `BACKLOG.md` is the driving document: Epics E0-E10, frozen design decisions
  D1-D10 (section 4). Work on one Epic per `epic/eN-...` branch, in order. Never push.

## Commands

Current state (pre-E1), PowerShell from the repo root:

```powershell
.\check.ps1     # javac everything into out/, then runs each Tests.*Test main()
.\run.ps1       # compile into out/ and launch Main
.\package.ps1   # check + jar + jpackage app-image -> dist\Calc\Calc.exe, dist\Calc-portable.zip
```

After Epic E1 (not done yet) these become Maven-based: `.\mvnw.cmd -B verify`,
JUnit 5, `target/calc.jar`; see BACKLOG.md E1. `mvn` is not installed (scoop would
provide it; ask the user first). No linter is configured.

## Architecture

Packages sit at the repo root (no `src/` yet); package names are deliberate and
must not be renamed before E9:

- `Calcul/` - engine, no Swing. `CalculatorEngine` validates and computes;
  `DecimalPolicy` (package-private) is the single place for parsing, rounding
  (12 decimals, HALF_UP), power exponent range (+-999) and normalisation;
  `NumberFormatter` formats results; `CalculationRecord` + `CalculationHistoryStore`
  / `FileCalculationHistoryStore` persist history (`%APPDATA%\Calc\history.tsv`,
  fallback `~/.calc/history.tsv`); `CalculationException` / `CalculationHistoryException`.
- `Graphique/` - MVP. `CalculatorPresenter` holds all interaction logic (history,
  status, focus, reuse); `CalculatorViewModel` is the immutable state handed to the
  view; `CalculatorFrame` is the Swing view only; `FocusTarget`, `ReuseTarget`,
  `StatusTone` are enums.
- `Tests/` - home-made tests: each class has a `main()` that runs `test...` methods
  and throws on the first failed assertion. 23 test methods total
  (engine 10, presenter 7, persistence 4, frame 2).

Invariants: the displayed result is exactly what is reused and persisted (one
value, no float drift); `+ - *` on decimals stay exact; only inexact results are
rounded; input accepts comma or point as decimal separator, no scientific notation;
the engine must not depend on Swing; the presenter must stay testable without a UI.

## Conventions

- Code, identifiers, comments, commits: English. UI strings: French **without
  accents** until Epic E8 (tests compare these strings).
- No behaviour change inside an infrastructure Epic (E1 is migration only).
- Out-of-scope problems found along the way go to `tasks/lessons.md`, not fixed.
- Pattern for scripts: guard `Remove-Item` with a check that the resolved path
  lives under the project root.

## Traps

- `Tests.CalculatorFrameTest` needs a display; it throws `AssertionError` when
  headless, which currently fails all of `check.ps1`. (Fixed by E1 via Assumptions.)
- `package.ps1` jars the whole `out/` folder, so test classes ship in the JAR
  (fixed by E1).
- The index is LF but the working tree on this machine is CRLF; without
  `.gitattributes` (added in E1) other environments see every file as modified.
- `out/` and `dist/` are gitignored build outputs; never commit them.
- The home-made test runner stops at the first failure and does not name tests.
- 6 existing `-Xlint:all` warnings are known and intentionally deferred.
